tasks.question_en: What was the year-over-year growth rate of store net sales in the Children category for March 1999?

      SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) AS amt FROM msb_store_sales
      WHERE d_date BETWEEN DATE '1999-03-01' AND DATE '1999-03-31' AND (i_category = 'Children')

      SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) AS amt FROM msb_store_sales
